services.name: Flu shot at home (self-pay price; the plan may pay)
services.story: The main story: Priya's home visit for Alex's flu shot and COVID-19 shot. Nothing is taken. The pharmacy bills Alex's plan its own way, often with nothing for Alex to pay.

services.name: Flu and COVID-19 shots at home
services.story: The same home visit, paid by Alex: nothing is taken, and Rosie texts the $245 bill (flu $45, COVID-19 $160, home visit $40) when Priya texts DONE.

services_shape: short shot visits of a set length, booked with a pharmacist by name or with whoever is on, with a 15-minute wait after every shot built into the booking; two or three shots fit in one visit and one wait; a shot is offered only while it's in stock, and its doses are set aside when the visit is booked; walk-ins are welcome when a pharmacist is free; medicine reviews at the pharmacy or by video; Rosie books shots and medicine reviews only, never prescriptions, refills or transfers
questions_before_times: which shots, or a medicine review: the pharmacy's own list only
for a shot in a series, like shingles: first or second dose
the patient's age group, since the state's age rules and some shot kinds depend on it
a health plan, a drug plan (names only), or self-pay
for a video review: which state the patient will be in
who the shots are for: the person booking, a child, or another adult
safety_stop: signs of a severe allergic reaction: trouble breathing, swelling of the face, lips or throat, hives spreading fast, or fainting after a shot
chest pain, signs of a stroke (a drooping face, a weak arm, slurred speech, a sudden severe headache), or very heavy bleeding
an overdose, or swallowed medicine or a chemical
first_steps: The screening questions and the consent
The pharmacist's review of the answers
A written price estimate for self-pay patients
license: always: each pharmacist holds their own active license from the state where the patient is during the visit; the pharmacy holds the state's pharmacy permit; whether a pharmacist needs extra vaccine training or a certificate, and whether trained technicians or interns may give shots, comes from the state's form (a switch)
staff_skills: pharmacists: shots, medicine reviews, home shot visits and shot clinics; only people cleared for home visits go to homes; trained technicians or interns give shots only where the state's form allows it, under a pharmacist (a switch)
messages_never: texts carry only the pharmacy's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never a shot's name, a medicine, a screening answer, a reaction or a health detail
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
